_plan.section_job: Validate the construct (convergent + discriminant) and pre-empt the scrutiny confound -- earn trust the residual measures what's claimed BEFORE results.
_plan.spine: P1 two demands -> P2 convergent ('consistent with', hedged) -> P3 discriminant (decisive; lead) -> P4 scrutiny rule-out pre-registration -> P5 define remaining key constructs.
_plan.serves: Construct credibility; pre-registers the 4.1 scrutiny rule-out; defines key non-main constructs.
_plan.boundary: Validity + scrutiny construct + key non-main constructs. MAIN var -> 2.3. Scrutiny RESULTS -> 4.1. Presentation-contrast RESULTS -> 4.2. Controls -> Appendix.
_plan.thin_claim: Convergent = 'consistent with' (weak, disclosed); discriminant = decisive but partly expected by construction (acknowledge); scrutiny = 'doesn't account for THIS run-up,' not 'never matters.'
_plan.division_of_labor: Mostly NEW -- validity is work 2.1 does not do. Presentation/Q&A split = CALLBACK P2. Scrutiny construct = definitional counterpart to the 2.2 P5 hypothesis.
_plan.validity_papers_status: hassan2020 (PRisk), baker2016/davis2016 (EPU), hoberg2010/hoberg2016 (competition) -- in the bib but NOT NLM-verified in 2.1; engaged here as benchmark claims -> VERIFY at write-time (NLM upload/query), flagged like pagan/opler. Our regression NUMBERS are bible-verbatim (claim ledger C3/C4/C5).

P1.intent: State the two demands the residual must meet before results are trusted: it must move with real uncertainty (convergent) and not be a scrutiny artifact (discriminant + rule-out).
P1.serves: Frames the validity gate; sets up P2-P4.
P1.thin_claim: Validity is asserted as an empirical question answered here, not assumed.
guardrails: The residual under test is the 2.3 UncResCEO (callback 2.3).

propositions.statement: The residual UncResCEO must satisfy two demands to be a credible measure: (a) convergent -- it moves with established uncertainty constructs; (b) discriminant -- it does not merely capture a confound such as analyst scrutiny.
propositions.verification_plan: Framing; forward from 2.3 P4.2 (validity = empirical question). Write-time pass.

P2.intent: Show the residual is 'consistent with' established uncertainty measures -- honestly hedged (one-tailed; PRisk economically trivial; US-EPU marginal).
P2.boundary: Convergent only; lead the validity story with discriminant (P3).
P2.thin_claim: 'Consistent with', NEVER 'establishes/moves with'; do not oversell (C5 weak).
guardrails: hassan2020/baker2016/davis2016 = NEW cites -> VERIFY at write-time (not now).

propositions.statement: The residual is positively associated with political risk (PRisk) and economic policy uncertainty (US-EPU, global EPU): PRisk->UncRes 0.0001*** (economically trivial, R2~0.003); US-EPU->UncRes 0.0124**/0.0123* (one-tailed; firm-FE marginal); GEPU->UncRes 0.0181**/0.0187** (one-tailed).
propositions.verification_plan: Numbers bible-verbatim. Benchmark papers (hassan2020, baker2016, davis2016) NOT yet verified -> what each measures = VERIFY at write-time.

propositions.statement: This is reported as 'consistent with' established measures, not as establishing the construct: the tests are one-tailed, the PRisk magnitude is economically trivial, and US-EPU is marginal (likely n.s. two-tailed). The convergent leg is supportive but weak.
propositions.verification_plan: Hedge VERBATIM from C5. Write-time pass.

P3.intent: Lead with the decisive validity result: a persistent industry condition (product-market competition) surfaces in the scripted presentation, NOT in the call-varying residual.
P3.serves: Discriminant leg (the CLEAN, lead result -- C3).
P3.boundary: Discriminant only; do not preview the 4.2 presentation-contrast results.
P3.thin_claim: Decisive, but acknowledge it is partly expected by construction (UncPre is an eq-4 control) -- do not over-claim full independence.
guardrails: hoberg2010/hoberg2016 = NEW cites -> VERIFY at write-time.

CONSTRUCTION SUBTLETY (advisor to adjudicate): competition loading on the presentation (UncPre) not the residual is consistent with -- and partly expected from -- UncPre being an eq-4 control; competition itself is NOT an eq-4 control, so the result is not purely mechanical, but frame it as supportive, not as wholly independent confirmation.
RULE-COH boundary: this is VALIDITY (presentation vs residual locus), distinct from the 4.2 two-audiences RESULT.

propositions.statement: Product-market competition loads on the scripted presentation uncertainty (UncPre) but not on the call-varying residual (UncRes): competition->UncPre 0.0304***/0.0302***; competition->UncRes 0.0008 n.s. (industry FE)/0.0023 n.s. (firm FE). N 12,728/18,492.
propositions.verification_plan: Numbers bible-verbatim. hoberg2010/2016 (what competition/fluidity measures) = VERIFY at write-time.

propositions.statement: This is the cleanest validity evidence and leads the validity story: a persistent industry trait surfaces where persistent content lives (the prepared presentation), not in the call-level residual that the design uses.

Acknowledge the construction subtlety: because UncPre is itself a control in the eq-4 first stage, any variation operating through presentation uncertainty is partialled out of the residual by construction; competition is not itself an eq-4 control, so the discriminant result is not purely mechanical, but it is partly expected and is presented as supportive rather than as fully independent confirmation.

source.note: UncPre is an eq-4 control (run_h0_3:369); claim ledger C3 risk notes UncPre->UncRes 0.0111**/0.0230** in a different/smaller sample so orthogonality is not purely mechanical.

propositions.verification_plan: Internal reasoning; ADVISOR to adjudicate whether to keep, soften, or strengthen. No NLM.

P4.intent: Define the scrutiny constructs and pre-register the three-step rule-out logic, framed as 'doesn't account for THIS run-up.'
P4.serves: The definitional counterpart to the 2.2 P5 hypothesis; routes the test to 4.1.
P4.boundary: Construct + pre-registration only; the RESULTS are 4.1.
P4.thin_claim: Keep EXACTLY as hedged: 'does not account for THIS run-up; not that scrutiny never matters' (C4, NULL-only, underpowered).
guardrails: RULE-COH-8: CashScrutiny = % of analyst Q&A turns on cash/liquidity (VOLUME), distinct from UncQue word-uncertainty (confirmed gen_empire_did_table.py:73).
RULE-COH-5: rule-out != mechanism; this is a confound check, not one of P7's two readings.
Keep C4 hedge VERBATIM; the confound IS real (HighCashScrutiny rises pre-announce) -- only the gating interaction kills it, and it is underpowered.
Results -> 4.1 (do not state them as established here beyond pre-registration).

propositions.statement: Define CashScrutiny = the share (%) of analyst Q&A turns devoted to cash/liquidity, and HighCashScrutiny = 1[CashScrutiny > median] (median = 0; ~11% of calls draw any cash scrutiny) -- a VOLUME/topic measure of analyst attention, distinct from the uncertainty wording of questions (UncQue).
propositions.verification_plan: Definition transcribed from code (RULE-COH-8 grounded). No NLM.

propositions.statement: Pre-register the three-step rule-out (executed in 4.1): (i) the measure is valid -- CashRatio predicts CashScrutiny (0.7530***/0.8519***); (ii) the channel is absent -- CashScrutiny->UncRes is null (~ -0.0000 n.s.); (iii) scrutiny does not gate the run-up -- the PreAnnounceQtr x scrutiny interaction is null (-0.0056 n.s.).
propositions.verification_plan: Numbers bible-verbatim; framed as pre-registration (results live in 4.1). No NLM.

propositions.statement: The conclusion is hedged exactly: the rule-out shows analyst scrutiny does not account for THIS pre-announcement run-up -- NOT that scrutiny never matters. The confound is genuine (HighCashScrutiny itself rises pre-announcement, 0.0408**); only the gating interaction rules it out, and that test is underpowered (absence of evidence, not equivalence).
propositions.verification_plan: Hedge VERBATIM from C4; RULE-COH-5 (rule-out != mechanism). Write-time pass.

P5.intent: Define the remaining key non-main constructs used in the designs: CashRatio, PreAnnounceQtr, CashScrutiny (with controls routed to the Appendix).
P5.serves: Closes the construct inventory; keeps definitions out of 2.3 (main var) and the Appendix (controls).
P5.boundary: Key non-main constructs only; MAIN var (UncRes) -> 2.3; controls -> Appendix.
guardrails: Definitions transcribed from code/bible; no memory.
PreAnnounceQtr already defined in 2.2 P1.2 + 2.4 P1.2 -> reference, do not redefine inconsistently.
CashScrutiny already defined in P4.1 -> reference.

propositions.statement: Define the key non-main constructs: CashRatio (the firm's cash-to-assets position); PreAnnounceQtr = 1[e=-1] (cross-reference 2.2/2.4); CashScrutiny / HighCashScrutiny (cross-reference P4.1). Remaining controls (Leverage, lnAssets, TobinsQ, ROA, Capex, DivDummy, sCFO, and the eq-4 controls) are catalogued in the Appendix.
